Corn futures were higher Tuesday with the Dec contract finishing the session at 426'2, higher by 4'4, or 1.07%. Total volume was a light 246,021, with Dec seeing 145,931 traded. Overall open interest rose by 2,036 (0.13%) to end the session with 1,540,576 outstanding. The Dec maturity dropped 0.0018%, or 2,036, to finish at 823,416.

Option trading centered around the Dec 440 calls with 6,328 changing hands and the Oct 425 puts with volume of 3,974. Option open interest is largest for the Dec 450 calls at 40,700, and the Dec 400 puts at 59,649.

Corn implied volatility ended the day moderately lower as CVL decreased 0.32 to close at 19.02. Dropping by 2.34% to a one month low, historical volatility (as measured by the 30-day) settled at 27.30%. The CVL Skew was moderately higher with the 30-day up by 0.076, closing at 1.21.

Corn futures were lower Monday with the Dec contract finishing the session at a one week low of 421'6, losing 2'2. Overall, a light 306,938 contracts were traded, with 189,769 done in Dec. Combined open interest fell by 8,423, or 0.54%, with Dec dropping by 10,583 (1.27%) to 823,422.

The Dec 400 put saw the most action with 3,714 contracts traded. Options with the greatest open interest are the Dec 450 call with 41,601, and the Dec 400 put with 59,744.

Implied Volatility ended higher with CVL adding 0.38, to finish the session at 19.34. The 30-day historical volatility finished adding 0.0864% to a one week high of 29.64%. The CVL Skew ended the session moderately lower, dropping 0.31 to finish at 1.14.

Friday's Corn market was mostly lower with the Dec contract adding 0'2 to 424'0. Overall the session saw a light 275,360 contracts done, with Dec volume coming in at 162,409. Across all maturities, open interest gained 9,133, or 0.59%, to 1,547,110. Dec decreased 896 (0.11%), finishing at 834,182.

The Oct 420 put saw the most changing hands with 3,151 contracts done. High volumes in Dec option trading were seen in the 430 calls (3,197) and the 400 puts (2,540). Option open interest is largest for the Dec 450 calls at 39,563, and the Dec 400 puts at 60,165.

Implied Volatility finished slightly down with CVL off 0.12, to end at a one week low of 18.96. Historical volatility (30-day) settled at 29.55%, dropping 0.0728%. The CVL Skew was slightly up with the 30-day adding 0.07, finishing the session at a one week high of 1.45.

Tuesday's Soybean market was higher with the Nov contract gaining 1'0 to 1012'0. Across all maturities, 264,254 contracts changed hands, with 147,291 traded in the Nov maturity. Total open interest lost 1,346, or 0.15%, to end the session with 925,009 outstanding. The Nov maturity decreased by 1.26% (1,346) to finish at 399,687.

Option volumes were highest for the Nov 1050 call (5,913) and the Nov 1000 put (7,986). Option open interest is largest for the Nov 1200 calls at 39,750, and the Nov 1000 puts at 37,763.

Soybean implied volatility finished the day lower as SVL fell by 0.36 to end at 15.96, a one week low. Historical volatility (30-day) settled at 16.84%, lower by 1.13%, to a one month low. The SVL Skew was slightly up with the 30-day gaining 0.19, closing the session at 0.15.

Nov Soybean futures closed the day at a one month low of 1011'0 Monday, off by 14'4 (1.41%). Overall, 313,996 contracts changed hands, with 188,011 traded in Nov. Total open interest closed the day at a one month high of 926,363, gaining 5,300, or 0.58%. Nov open interest shed 1,761 (0.43%), to 404,781.

The Oct 1020 put saw the most changing hands with 10,533 contracts done. Calls with the greatest open interest are the Nov 1200 strike (39,749), and for the puts are the Nov 1000 strike (36,391).

As measured by SVL, implied volatility finished the session higher, gaining 0.35 to end the day at 16.32. The 30-day historical volatility settled losing 0.83% to a one month low of 17.97%. The SVL Skew was sharply lower with the 30-day off by 0.83, closing at a one month low of -0.04.

Soybean futures were lower Friday with the Nov contract finishing the session at a one week low of 1025'4, dropping 12'0, or 1.16%, in volatile trade. Across all maturities, volume was 302,760, with Nov seeing 184,812 done. Combined open interest ended at a one month high of 921,068, up 6,571 (0.72%). Nov open interest added 3,044, or 0.75%, to 406,558.

Option trading centered around the Oct 1050 calls with 6,658 traded and the Oct 1030 puts with volume of 11,765. Largest volumes in Nov option trading were seen in the 1100 calls (6,596) and the 1000 puts (4,304). Options with the largest open interest are the Nov 1200 call with 39,750, and the Nov 1000 put with 34,039.

Soybean implied volatility ended the session sharply down as SVL shed 1.3 to finish the day at 15.96, a one week low. The 30-day historical volatility ended the day adding 0.29% to a one week high of 18.80%. The SVL Skew closed sharply down, off 1.4 to end the session at 0.79, a one month low.

Dec Wheat futures settled at 520'4 Tuesday, up 9'6 (1.91%). Combined volume was 112,052, with the Dec maturity seeing 71,968 done. Across all maturities, open interest fell 2,304, or 0.49%, to end the session with 465,012 outstanding. The Dec maturity decreased 1.54% (2,304) to finish at 263,930.

Option trading centered around the Dec 520 calls with 1,555 changing hands and the Dec 500 puts with volume of 1,245. Options with the largest open interest are the Dec 600 call with 5,307, and the Dec 500 put with 5,447.

Implied Volatility ended moderately down with WVL lower by 0.26, to finish at a one week low of 21.05. Dropping by 0.0890%, historical volatility (as measured by the 30-day) ended the day at 20.82%. The WVL Skew was moderately up with the 30-day higher by 0.13, closing the day at 3.86.

Dec Wheat futures finished the session at a contract low of 510'6 Monday, dropping by 11'6 or 2.25%. Combined volume was 135,658, with Dec seeing 86,785 change hands. Overall open interest closed the session at a one month high of 467,726, higher by 7,592, or 1.65%. Dec open interest increased 5,004 (1.90%), to 268,471.

The Oct 520 put saw the most changing hands with 1,083 contracts done. Options with the highest open interest are the Dec 600 call with 5,309, and the Dec 500 put with 5,226.

Wheat implied volatility ended the day moderately down as WVL fell by 0.79 to close at 21.31, a one week low. Up by 1.15% to a one week high, historical volatility (as measured by the 30-day) finished the session at 20.91%. The WVL Skew closed moderately lower, off 0.15 to settle at a one week low of 3.73.

Friday's Wheat market was lower with the Dec contract down 1'6 to 522'4, a one week low. Overall, a light 73,461 contracts were traded, with 45,048 done in Dec. Total open interest increased 2,235 (0.49%) to 460,817. Dec added 2,972, or 1.14%, finishing at 264,147.

Option trading centered around the Oct 520 calls with 744 changing hands and the Nov 485 puts with volume of 530. In Dec options, the highest volume call was in the 555 strike with 333 done, and the 500 put leads with volume of 239. Calls with the greatest open interest are the Dec 600 strike (5,305), and for the puts are the Dec 500 strike (5,161).

Implied Volatility settled down with WVL dropping 0.4, to close the day at 22.10. Off by 0.0886% to a one month low, historical volatility (as measured by the 30-day) settled at 19.75%. The WVL Skew closed the day moderately higher, adding 0.12 to finish at a one month high of 3.88.
